# Keep migration cleanup and startup defaults as separate behavior changes

479 also changes menubar autohide defaults and verifyExistingAccounts/new-profile flow while deleting old migrations. Current messenger.xhtml still has autohide=true. Removing dead migration code can alter fresh-profile behavior through adjacent default edits; review both paths and do not infer safety solely from age. Bug 1901705 context references1908054; its detailed downstream fix has not been inspected here.

Scope: mail/base/content.
